parakeet: The reality check here is that religion is not equivalent with the moral safeguard. History shows us that religion has not only failed to keep societies moral, but has actively enabled slavery, with scriptures such as slaves obey your masters. It has sanctioned genocide because of the Old Testament wars, oppressed women, limiting leadership, autonomy, and voice, and even justified colonization and cultural erasure, civilizing the heathen. This has also fueled holy wars, including the crusades, inquisitions, and terrorism. Often these atrocities were done in the name of righteousness. So if religion was designed to keep society moral, it's got some serious explaining to do.
